annotations.title: IBC test and inspection due dates

description: Work out an IBC's next leakproofness test, 2.5-year and 5-year inspections, the last month it may be filled and (UN/ADR, plastic and composite IBCs) the end of its five-year life. Dates as MM/YYYY, "March 2024" or YYYY-MM. Needs made, or a mark it can read the month of manufacture from.

bottle.description: Month the inner receptacle was replaced (remanufactured composite IBCs)

code.description: IBC code, e.g. 31HA1, if no mark

leak.description: Month of the last leakproofness test

mark.description: The IBC UN mark; code and month of manufacture are read from it

regime.description: un (UN Model Regulations and ADR, default) or us (49 CFR 180.352)
